messages.subject: R 4.0.2
parts:
There is a serious bug in R itself that can cause R to crash
when used with tcltk affecting R version 4.0 and 4.0.1.
but not earlier versions of R.

This bug can potentially affect sqldf and gsubfn.  R 4.0.2
fixes this problem and will be released on June 22, 2020.
